extracted.name: Pashka
extracted.description: This pashka is a no-cook, creamy traditional Russian Easter dish like cheesecake without the crust. It may be enjoyed anytime, not just at the holidays.
instruction_lines: Blend cream cheese, cottage cheese, sour cream, and butter together in a medium bowl until thoroughy combined.
Gradually fold in sugar, almonds, currants, vanilla, and lemon extract. Transfer to a shallow medium dish. Cover with a cloth and chill in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight.
